# HEM v0.6.2b7 — Automatic settings saves without value flicker

## Settings menus
- Home, Room, Device and Floor settings save from the edited control. Dropdowns, switches and selections save on change; valid typed values use a short 450 ms debounce, with change/Enter flushing native numeric/time inputs. Ordinary settings no longer have Save/Apply buttons.
- Keep the edited value visible through delayed service responses and older state updates. Native settings show Saving, Waiting for confirmation and Saved separately; only the matching HA state confirms a native value. No optimistic writes into `hass.states`.
- Serialize writes per configuration entry. Home/Room Options transactions fetch fresh server defaults and merge only deliberately edited fields, preserving unrelated settings and keeping the same dialog, focus and open sections.
- Floor registry updates write only the edited property or room assignment; stale registry responses cannot overwrite an unconfirmed edit, and refresh no longer closes the floor editor.
- Invalid values remain unsent. Failures retain the edit and expose an explicit Retry. Missing native or floor confirmation is reported after 15 seconds instead of pretending success or retrying indefinitely. Late matching confirmation clears the warning without issuing another write. Pending unsent edits/timers are cancelled on context change or dialog removal.

## Clearer help
- Replace save-timing subtitles with descriptions of the menu's purpose in English, Greek and German.
- Keep the existing category grouping, concise labels and Windows → Door contacts → Eco → Shades arrangement.
- Calibration, Reset, Resume and other action buttons remain deliberate actions; they are not triggered by opening or refreshing a menu.

## Verification and scope
- Add browser regressions for delayed/out-of-order native state, rapid changes, validation, failed-save retry, fresh Options transactions, device ownership and Home/Room/Device menus in EN/EL/DE at mobile/desktop sizes. Update floor and existing menu/service-target regression tests for automatic saving.
- Frontend behaviour only, plus tests/release metadata. The b4 startup fix and b6 dispatch-evidence fix are retained. No controller safety, PID, device authority or Announcement Hub routing changes.

Update through HACS and fully reload the dashboard to load the new card. Follow HACS's reload/restart prompt for the installed integration. The release process does not install on or restart your server or operate appliances.
